evidence.excerpt: Recipient Name: JUPITER VOLTA INC; Award Amount: 3650757.0; Start Date: 2026-03-26; Awarding Agency: Department of Energy; Awarding Sub Agency: Department of Energy; Description: NEW AWARD: JUPITER VOLTA, INC. CONTROL NUMBER 3387-2097 VISION OPEN 2024 PROJECT TITLE: ''DIAMOND-METAL COMPOSITE STRUCTURED MATERIALS FOR USE IN EXTREME ENVIRONMENTS.'' THE PROJECT WILL DELIVER AN OPERATIONAL RAD PRINTER AND 3D DIAMOND-METAL COMPOSITES FOR CUSTOMER EVALUATION AS FUSION FACING MATERIALS, PLASMA THRUSTERS, AND EXTREME-CURRENT ELECTRODES. TIE TO VISION OPEN GOAL: THIS PROJECT ALIGNS WITH ARPA-E’S VISION OPEN GOAL OF CARBON AS A SUSTAINABLE BUILDING BLOCK BY CONVERTING METHANE FEEDSTOCK INTO HIGH-PERFORMANCE DIAMOND MATERIALS. THE RAD PRINTER ALSO SUPPORTS THE PATH TO NET-ZERO BY 2050 BY PROVIDING SUSTAINABLE, LOW-GHG MATERIALS FOR THE CLEAN ENERGY TRANSITION AND ENABLING OTHER BREAKTHROUGHS.
